description: This file contains functions related to migrating LED sysfs configurations and applying configuration changes within an OpenWRT system, including functions for migrating and removing LED sysfs entries, as well as applying configuration changes to a specified realm.

methods.name: migrate_led_sysfs
methods.description: Updates the sysfs path of a specified LED configuration based on provided tuples, and logs the change.

methods.name: remove_devicename_led_sysfs
methods.description: Removes the device name prefix from sysfs path of a specified LED configuration unless exemptions apply, and logs the change.

methods.name: migrate_leds
methods.description: Loads system configuration and applies LED sysfs migrations using 'migrate_led_sysfs' for each 'led' configuration.

methods.name: remove_devicename_leds
methods.description: Loads system configuration and removes device name prefixes from all 'led' configurations.

methods.name: migrations_apply
methods.description: Applies configuration changes to a specified realm if there are pending changes.
